description: Register the module and confirm the code graph is reachable (code-graph status).
Refactor Detective persona/router — dispatches to the full workflow roster (log analysis, ten detectors, audit-all, governance, apply-and-verify, CI gate, ticket export).
Get any test suite from zero to N genuine execution runs, diagnosing and fixing environment/discovery blockers along the way. Standalone, or an automatic prerequisite for Analyze Test Reliability.

Classify false positives (flaky tests) and false negatives (tests that pass without really checking anything) from execution logs across multiple runs. Generalizes across JUnit/Surefire XML, Playwright JSON, and Jenkins console logs.
outputs: findings (Real Failure/False Positive/False Negative/Healthy) + diff proposals

description: Find test-to-test coupling and cascade risk from shared fixtures, order-dependence, or shared live app/data state.
Find fragile selectors, fixed waits, and unhandled overlays/dialogs, corroborated against logs when available.
Find shared/non-reusable test data and missing setup/teardown lifecycle gaps.
Find structurally similar or duplicate code via the knowledge graph's SIMILAR_TO similarity edges.
Find high-complexity/cognitive-load hotspots, hidden O(n^2) scans, and unguarded recursion via graph complexity metrics. Generalizes beyond test suites to any codebase.

Find diagnosability gaps — silent catches, exception-dropping logs, unlogged external calls/loop failure paths, missing failure screenshots/traces — tagged app/env/data/script-error. Generalizes beyond test suites to any codebase.
Find hardcoded URLs/credentials/secrets, inline environment-switch logic, hardcoded timeouts, and unsafe forced-serial parallel-execution config.

Find duplicated selector literals across page objects, missing locator-priority tiering, and absence of a centralized element repository. Distinct from Detect Instability's per-selector fragility check.
Find architecture/layering gaps: missing or mixed layers (tests/pages/components/data/utils/config/reporting), cross-layer violations, naming-convention drift.
Find outdated technology versions (Java, JUnit, Spring, Selenium, Maven, npm deps) and propose modernization upgrades ranked by security severity, breaking-change risk, and effort.
Run all ten detectors against a project (full or incremental scan) and produce one consolidated HTML report ranked by estimated impact, with a trend against the last tracked run.
outputs: HTML audit report + diff proposals + audit-history snapshot

description: Reads a completed Audit All run for gap types recurring 3+ times across files — the evidence that an unwritten convention needs documenting or enforcing, plus repo-governance-artifact gaps (CONTRIBUTING, CODEOWNERS, lint config).

Apply a chosen proposal diff to the target project for real and run its test suite to confirm the result. The only capability that edits source directly, invoked explicitly by the owner. Optional auto-rollback on a genuine regression.
outputs: applied source changes + real test-report results

description: Thin wrapper around Audit All — fails only when a new Critical-or-above opportunity appears since the last tracked run; pre-existing debt doesn't block every build.

Turn the top-N ranked opportunities from a completed Audit All run into GitLab issues. Requires two explicit confirmations (scope, then destination) — the only capability writing to a shared external system.
